findings.evidence: `isOpen_Ioo.eqOn_of_deriv_eq isPreconnected_Ioo` at line 228 is the only connectivity use, and `IsOpen.eqOn_of_deriv_eq` is stated for a general `(hs : IsOpen s) (hs' : IsPreconnected s)` at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/MeanValue.lean:779; the `Icc a b ⊆ s` step of `ne_zero` (lines 173-176) follows for general such `s` from `IsPreconnected.ordConnected` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Order/IntermediateValue.lean:207) plus openness at the two margin points.
findings.fix: Replace `{A B : ℝ}`/`Ioo A B` by `{s : Set ℝ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hs' : IsPreconnected s)` in all four theorems, e.g. `theorem IsOneLoopRGSolution.eq_oneLoopCoupling {s : Set ℝ} {t₀ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : IsOneLoopRGSolution β₀ s f) (hs : IsOpen s) (hs' : IsPreconnected s) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ s) (h₀ : f t₀ ≠ 0) : ∀ t ∈ s, f t = oneLoopCoupling β₀ (f t₀) (t - t₀)`; then also state the maximal-domain instance `IsOneLoopRGSolution β₀ (Ioi (landauTime β₀ a₀)) (oneLoopCoupling β₀ a₀)` so the two halves match.
findings.issue: `IsOneLoopRGSolution.ne_zero` (:168), `.inv_eq` (:216), `.eq_oneLoopCoupling` (:237) and `.add_landauTime_notMem` (:252) are all stated on `Ioo A B` with `A B : ℝ`, which excludes unbounded intervals — in particular `Ioi (landauTime β₀ a₀)`, the maximal domain used by `strictAntiOn_oneLoopCoupling` (:275) and `tendsto_oneLoopCoupling_nhdsGT_landauTime` (:322), and `{t | 1 + β₀ * a₀ * t ≠ 0}`, the domain of `isOneLoopRGSolution_oneLoopCoupling` (:162). The existence and uniqueness halves therefore never meet on a common domain, and the roadmap's "no solution extends below the Landau time" is obtained only for bounded windows.

summary: The uniqueness, separation-of-variables, nonvanishing and no-extension theorems are all restricted to a bounded interval `Ioo A B` with real endpoints, so they do not apply to the maximal domain `Ioi (landauTime β₀ a₀)` on which the file's own solution lives, nor to `Ioi`/`Iio`/`univ` generally. Mathlib's `IsOpen.eqOn_of_deriv_eq` and `IsPreconnected.ordConnected` make the open-preconnected statement directly provable by the same proofs.
